units.source_text: 话虽如此，现在也没有丝毫责备那女人的心思。

en.t: That said, I do not now have the slightest desire to blame the woman.

units.source_text: 我可以清楚地保证：她既非淑女，亦非妓女。

en.t: I can state quite clearly: she is neither a lady nor a prostitute.

units.source_text: 假如需要附信的话，我的图章就是按一二十下，也随时都高高兴兴地给她按。

en.t: If a letter of recommendation were needed, I would gladly stamp it for her at any time, even ten or twenty times over.

units.source_text: 只是和我一样，没有掌握往返车票的本事，可以说是个傻女人。

en.t: It is just that, like me, she never mastered the trick of holding a round-trip ticket, so one might call her a foolish woman.

units.source_text: 可是即使都是往返车票，出发地不同，自然目的地也不同。

en.t: But even with round-trip tickets, if the point of departure is different, then naturally the destination is different too.

units.source_text: 返回这儿的车票，对对方来说可是“往”的车票，这并没有什么不可思议的。

en.t: A ticket returning here would be an outbound ticket for the other person, and there is nothing strange about that.
